meta.name: Saare Jahan Se Accha
meta.description: A resilient Indian spy must defeat his counterpart across the border in a battle of wits and tradecraft to sabotage a nuclear program.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Intelligence agent Vishnu discovers CIA surveillance on India's nuclear plans, while Pakistan's top scientists secretly meet with the prime minister.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Murtaza chases an informant, Vishnu secretly meets Naushad. Amid rising threats, Mohini and Vishnu receive an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Murtaza makes a tough call. Kao urges Vishnu to get closer to journalist Fatima Khan. Vishnu uncovers a startling connection.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As threats close in on Fatima, Vishnu comes to her with an offer. A volatile clash brews between Sukhbir and Rizwan.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A guilt-ridden Sukhbir confides in Vishnu. Kao heads to the United States, while the agency prepares to intercept the cargo bound for Pakistan.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Fatima is given a critical task. A frustrated Murtaza calls a meeting. Can Vishnu and the team complete their mission before time runs out?
